topic: How to Make Wedding Invitations in Canva (Print-Ready A7 + On-the-Day Set)

images.name: wrong-envelopes
images.prompt: Warm photographic close-up of a box of small cream envelopes just opened on a table beside a much larger wedding invitation card that plainly will not fit inside them, soft morning window light, shallow depth of field, quiet dismay, no readable text

images.name: card-wont-fit
images.prompt: Macro photograph of two hands trying to slide a large cream invitation card into an envelope that is far too small, the card buckling slightly at the corner, soft daylight, very shallow depth of field, no readable text

images.name: post-office-counter
images.prompt: Photographic over-the-shoulder shot of a single sealed cream envelope resting on a post office counter scale, warm indoor light, out-of-focus counter behind, calm and ordinary, no readable text or signage

images.name: on-the-day-table
images.prompt: Warm photographic image of a laid wedding reception table with a folded place card and a standing table number in a simple frame, candlelight and greenery, shallow depth of field, elegant and understated, no readable text

images.name: finished-suite
images.prompt: Flat-lay photograph of a complete wedding invitation suite on a linen surface — invitation, details card and reply card stacked with a cream envelope and a sprig of eucalyptus, soft natural light, shallow depth of field, no readable text

product.name: Party & Event Printables Kit
product.note: ALREADY BUILT. No new pack. Add the wedding suite to it: invitation 5x7, details card 5x7, RSVP 3.5x5, order of service A5, place card, table number.
